basis: Annotator qwen3.5:4b on every tier; Skills and synthesis on the largest model the RAM holds. Measured on a 16 GB Mac with Ollama 0.34.2: gemma4:12b-it-qat takes 40+ s per annotated frame (11 s image prefill + 30 s decode) against a 3 s budget. With ordinary apps open, qwen3.5:4b (3.4 GB) and gemma4:12b-it-qat (7.2 GB) do not fit together, so the worker loads one at a time: annotation first, then Skills.
